note: Genesis: RNG Labs receives the whole supply (1,000,000,000 RNG = 10^15 atoms) in one allocation ($DEPLOYER on testnet; the Labs wallet on mainnet). Distribution is by transfers in the runbook (deploy/README.md): 250,000,000 RNG under DAO control in the beacon (reserve via X-Foundation, treasury via X-Treasury; the DAO process itself can never move the token it stakes), and validatorRng to each launch validator, bonded whole (4 x stake). A later Paralith allocation is not part of launch.
